check_package_versions: run the release tool to check local package versions against latest PyPI releases
build_packages: build sdist and wheel distributions for packages with newer local versions than PyPI
bump_version: bump the version number in a package's init file or setup.py to the next version
get_package_info: get a package's name, local version, and latest PyPI version from its directory path
get_metadata: fetch and parse PyPI JSON metadata for a given package name into an OmegaConf DictConfig
